# MGHYN Clinic ERP

> Clinic management and billing platform for aesthetic and wellness clinics in India — GST-compliant invoicing, package session wallets, appointment scheduling, inventory and CRM.

The public site hosts resources about clinic billing and practice management. The application itself (dashboard, POS, appointments, inventory, CRM) is private and requires staff sign-in.

## Pages

- [Selecting Medical Billing Software for Aesthetic Clinics](/resources/medical-billing-guide): A practical guide to GST/SAC compliance, package session tracking, split payments, and safe invoice edits when choosing medical billing software.
